scope: Validated recording ingestion and seekable playback; ROS/rosbag2 and the Blender showroom remain future work

qt_free_headless.method: Fresh out-of-tree configure in build/qtfree-check, then dumpbin /dependents

writer_format_unchanged.method: Byte comparison of an 8 s run with --grip-event 6:0.45 written by the previous executable and by the rewritten shared writer

recording_playback_tests.fixture: one lap, two accepted grip changes (1.0 -> 0.8 at 4 s, -> 0.6 at 20 s), three plan revisions
recording_playback_tests.round_trip: every reloaded sample matches the live simulation's time, x, y, speed and revision
recording_playback_tests.backward_seek: revision 3 at the end; seeking between events restores revision 2 and mu 0.8; seeking before the first event restores revision 1 and mu 1.0 with its higher first-corner plan speed
recording_playback_tests.event_boundary: the sample at the event time keeps the old revision; the next tick's sample carries the new one
rejected_examples: plan-rev-2.csv generated_time_s does not match the parameter event that produced it
events.csv line 3 old_value does not continue the configuration chain
telemetry.csv line 803 revision disagrees with events.csv timing
telemetry.csv line 7 time_s must increase strictly
telemetry.csv header does not match the schema 1 contract
plan-rev-2.csv line 4 geometry does not match track.csv
plan.csv must be identical to plan-rev-1.csv
a plan revision exists without a recorded parameter event
recording_playback_tests.edited_plan_speed: loads, then planner reproduction reports a difference above 1 m/s

qml_controls.method: Actual QML controls, bindings and QQuickWindow captures
replay_checks: invalid directory refused and the status names the recording contract
seek to 8 s applies the recorded change; readout shows the recorded mu 0.45
seek back to 3 s restores revision 1, mu 1.00 and the higher first-corner plan speed
Play advances the playhead while the live plant stays at simulation time 0 and revision 1
dragging the playhead seeks to the recorded sample
Exit replay restores the live simulation with its time, revision and grip untouched

limitations: playback reads this project's schema 1 only; not rosbag2
recorded-input replay cannot evaluate a different closed-loop policy
whole recording is loaded into memory; no streaming reader
replay speed fixed at 1.0 with no frame-step control
rear-axle margin is not swept-body collision
